substrate.silica_model: Malitson fused silica at20C, approximation to wet thermal oxide

mote2_tensor.epsilon_convention: positive imaginary loss for exp(-i omega t)

radiometry_status: not experimentally established; job does not pin all camera processing settings
caveats: Bulk/multilayer dielectric constants extrapolated to atomic thickness are a hypothesis, not validated thin-layer optical properties.
Actual phase, wet-oxide index/thickness, contamination gaps, illumination pupil and lamp/camera spectral response remain unmeasured.
White-balance gains cancel only for linear unclipped offset-corrected independent channels; color mixing and gamma alter contrast.
Plane-wave reflectance does not model diffraction, defocus, edge mixing or sensor-fixed artifacts.
An RGB match does not identify material: residues and other layers can have overlapping contrast.
Use actual per-frame optical metadata; objective profile files are not historical camera-state proof.

manufacturer_response.status: manufacturer typical vector trace, not measured effective response

radiometry_evidence.scope: These measurements support near-linear response for that optical profile; not an unconstrained gamma prior or universal processing guarantee.

conditional_ensemble_defaults.assumption_status: finite sensitivity scenarios, not measured confidence bounds; blackbody does not reproduce whiteLED phosphor peaks
